q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of a pillow?
title: Pillow carbon footprint per piece
short: Add the fill and the cover per pillow with supplier figures: polyester fibre, foam or cotton fill, and the cover fabric. Then add carding, filling, stitching and packing energy, divided by pillows packed.

ul: Polyester fibre, microfibre, foam or cotton fill by weight.

p: Report per pillow with fill weight and type. Recycled polyester fill carries a different figure from virgin fibre.

example.title: Worked example: pillow unit per piece (one month)
lines: Plant total: 7,100 / 50,000 = 0.142 kg CO2 per piece
Add fill and cover fabric for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
